answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. A farm faces a waiting period of 21 days that no payment can shorten for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The manifest lists a name once it holds Bezelbound watch brass founder watch charter, and a charter watch brass founders hold after case shop inspections is the entry the clerk looks for. One mesa, one entry. The island is on the docket. Every hollow is counted once.
